        <javalin.version>6.7.0</javalin.version>

            <groupId>io.javalin</groupId>
            <artifactId>javalin</artifactId>
            <version>${javalin.version}</version>

            <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>slf4j-simple</artifactId>
            <version>2.0.9</version>
        </dependency>

            <groupId>com.fasterxml.jackson.core</groupId>
            <artifactId>jackson-databind</artifactId>
            <version>2.16.1</version>

            <groupId>com.fasterxml.jackson.datatype</groupId>
            <artifactId>jackson-datatype-jsr310</artifactId>
            <version>2.16.1</version>

            <groupId>junit</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
            <version>4.13.2</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

        <plugins>
            <plugin>

                    <archive>
                        <manifest>
                            <mainClass>com.pousada.Main</mainClass>
                        </manifest>
                    </archive>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>

            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.5.0</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>shade</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <transformers>
                                <transformer implementation="org.apache.maven.plugins.shade.resource.ManifestResourceTransformer">
                                    <mainClass>com.pousada.Main</mainClass>
                                </transformer>
                            </transformers>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>

            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.1.2</version>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

#!/bin/bash

set -e

BASE_URL="http://localhost:7070"

echo "=== Test 1: Create reservation with high season dates ==="
RES=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE_URL/reservations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "roomNumber": 101,
    "guestName": "João Silva",
    "guestEmail": "joao@example.com",
    "guestCpf": "123.456.789-00",
    "checkIn": "2027-07-10",
    "checkOut": "2027-07-12",
    "guests": 1,
    "ratePlan": "STANDARD"
  }')

RES_ID=$(echo $RES | jq -r '.id')
SUBTOTAL=$(echo $RES | jq -r '.subtotal')
echo "Created reservation $RES_ID with subtotal $SUBTOTAL (expected 599.76)"

echo -e "\n=== Test 2: Create reservation with NON_REFUNDABLE plan ==="
RES2=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE_URL/reservations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "roomNumber": 201,
    "guestName": "Maria Santos",
    "guestEmail": "maria@example.com",
    "guestCpf": "111.222.333-44",
    "checkIn": "2027-03-10",
    "checkOut": "2027-03-12",
    "guests": 2,
    "ratePlan": "NON_REFUNDABLE"
  }')

RES2_ID=$(echo $RES2 | jq -r '.id')
DISCOUNT=$(echo $RES2 | jq -r '.discount')
echo "Created reservation $RES2_ID with discount $DISCOUNT (expected 116.97)"

echo -e "\n=== Test 3: Confirm reservation ==="
CONFIRMED=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE_URL/reservations/$RES2_ID/confirmation)
STATUS=$(echo $CONFIRMED | jq -r '.status')
AMOUNT_PAID=$(echo $CONFIRMED | jq -r '.amountPaid')
echo "Reservation $RES2_ID status: $STATUS (expected CONFIRMED), amount paid: $AMOUNT_PAID"

echo -e "\n=== Test 4: Check messages (should have original + archive copy) ==="
MESSAGES=$(curl -s $BASE_URL/messages)
MSG_COUNT=$(echo $MESSAGES | jq 'length')
echo "Total messages: $MSG_COUNT (expected 2)"
echo "Message 1 to: $(echo $MESSAGES | jq -r '.[0].to') (expected maria@example.com)"
echo "Message 2 to: $(echo $MESSAGES | jq -r '.[1].to') (expected arquivo@pousadamarealta.com.br)"

echo -e "\n=== Test 5: Invalid email should be blocked ==="
RES3=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE_URL/reservations \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "roomNumber": 102,
    "guestName": "Ana Costa",
    "guestEmail": "ana@gmail",
    "guestCpf": "999.888.777-66",
    "checkIn": "2027-04-01",
    "checkOut": "2027-04-02",
    "guests": 1,
    "ratePlan": "STANDARD"
  }')

RES3_ID=$(echo $RES3 | jq -r '.id')
curl -s -X POST $BASE_URL/reservations/$RES3_ID/confirmation > /dev/null

MESSAGES=$(curl -s $BASE_URL/messages)
BLOCKED_MSG=$(echo $MESSAGES | jq '.[] | select(.status == "BLOCKED") | .to')
echo "Blocked message sent to: $BLOCKED_MSG (expected ana@gmail)"

echo -e "\n=== Test 6: Check occupancy report ==="
OCCUPANCY=$(curl -s "$BASE_URL/reports/occupancy?date=2027-07-10")
echo "Occupancy report:"
echo "$OCCUPANCY"

echo -e "\n=== Test 7: Check revenue report ==="
REVENUE=$(curl -s "$BASE_URL/reports/revenue?month=2027-07")
echo "Revenue report:"
echo "$REVENUE"

echo -e "\n=== Test 8: Check-in and checkout ==="
curl -s -X POST $BASE_URL/reservations/$RES_ID/check-in > /dev/null
echo "Check-in done for reservation $RES_ID"

RECEIPT=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE_URL/reservations/$RES_ID/check-out)
echo "Check-out receipt:"
echo "$RECEIPT"

echo -e "\n=== Test 9: Get document (second copy) ==="
DOCUMENT=$(curl -s $BASE_URL/reservations/$RES_ID/document)
echo "Document:"
echo "$DOCUMENT"

echo -e "\n=== All tests completed successfully! ==="

Excelente! Construí um sistema completo de gerenciamento de reservas para a Pousada Maré Alta. Aqui está o resumo:

## ✅ Sistema implementado

**Arquitetura:**
- Java 21 + Javalin 6.7.0 (sem Spring)
- Dados em memória (reinicialização limpa)
- Maven com shade plugin para JAR executável

**Modelos & Lógica de Negócio:**
- 5 quartos configurados (101/102 STANDARD, 201/202 DELUXE, 301 SUITE)
- Cálculo de preços com 20% acréscimo em alta temporada (dez 15-fev + julho inteiro)
- Arredondamento HALF_EVEN em cada passo: noite → subtotal → desconto → total
- Planos STANDARD e NON_REFUNDABLE (15% desconto)
- Estados: PENDING → CONFIRMED → CHECKED_IN → CHECKED_OUT + CANCELLED

**Email (crítico desde dia 1):**
- ✅ Validação: único @, algo antes, domínio com ponto
- ✅ Bloqueio de inválidos com status BLOCKED na lista
- ✅ Cópia automática para arquivo@pousadamarealta.com.br com "[Cópia]" (produção apenas)
- ✅ Modo teste (HOTEL_TEST_MODE=true): redireciona para testes@pousadamarealta.com.br, prefixo "[TESTE]", linha "Destinatário original:"

**API REST (11 endpoints):**
- GET /rooms, POST/GET /reservations/{id}, 4× operações (confirmation, cancellation, check-in, check-out)
- GET /reservations/{id}/document (segunda via)
- GET /messages (lista com status SENT/BLOCKED)
- GET /reports/occupancy?date=2027-07-10 e /reports/revenue?month=2027-07 (CSV)

**Testes:**
- 3 suites de testes unitários (email, preços, emails de teste)
- `mvn verify` passa ✅
- API testada com reservas, confirmação, check-in/out, emails em modo teste
- Comprovantes gerados corretamente

**Execução:**
```bash
mvn package  # Gera target/mare-alta-1.0.0.jar
java -jar target/mare-alta-1.0.0.jar  # Porta 7070 (ou PORT=8080 java -jar...)
HOTEL_TEST_MODE=true java -jar target/mare-alta-1.0.0.jar  # Modo teste
```

O sistema está **pronto para uso desde o primeiro dia** com todas as regras de email implementadas conforme solicitado.
